232bdc0f3402ae54d45ec48bd856e03f420bca56.summary: A GitHub-hosted indicator-of-compromise list for the MICROPSIA (APT-C-23) actor. It contains a YARA rule, nine sample hashes, a delivery URL and links to external reporting. The page gives no narrative on sectors, countries, CVEs or detailed techniques. Latest commit: Aug 15, 2019.

dates.what: latest commit to the IoC page

2346a33266d24548bea515a9fdca011e9e26d6c0.summary: This is a GitHub project README for a Linux tool named 3snake that captures password-related strings from running SSH and sudo processes on servers, aimed at rooted machines. It is a tool's own project page, not a threat report, so no facts are recorded.
